text:
Anita C: FYI AcmePayments just asked to onboard a customer-supplied model for fraud detection — they called it `acme-fraud-v2`.
Marco V: quick summary from their PM? payloads, expected qps, any PII?
Anita C: PM says: small batches, ~5 qps steady, peak 50 qps. Model trained on transaction traces, includes hashed user ids, no raw card numbers. They want it in Dedicated for latency/SLA.
Priya S: Got it. Any safety constraints or red-teaming asks from legal/compliance?
Anita C: Legal flagged potential transaction manipulation prompts and wants strict output filters + evals for hallucination on policy-critical fields.
Marco V: Ok. Two parallel tracks: 1) infra: sizing + isolation (Dedicated). 2) safety/eval: test suite for false positives/negatives and prompt injections.
Priya S: I'll kick off onboarding checklist. Need model format, tokenizer, sample payloads, and an explainer eval set (50-100 examples labeled). Ask Acme to provide a small golden set.
Anita C: They can share 200 synthetic + 100 labeled examples. Also asked about quantization — they want int8 to save cost.
eng-ml-oncall: Note: int8 quantization ok if model arch supported. We'll need a 1-3GB validation run to confirm perf/regression.
safety-bot: @Anita C please submit a safety ticket with threat model + example prompts. Use template: https://redwood.internal/safety/onboard-template
Anita C: filed SAF-4821 with customer threat model and attachments.
Marco V: For evals: propose two suites — dev (smoke, 200 samples) and prod (regression + adversarial, 1k samples). We'll run both before canary.
Priya S: Who owns the adversarial generation? Eng-ML or customer?
eng-ml-oncall: We'll run automated adversarial fuzzing and also need customer-supplied edge cases. Send their examples to eng-ml-runner queue.
Anita C: I'll coordinate and upload the sample sets to the onboarding bucket: s3://redwood-onboard/acmepayments/acme-fraud-v2
Priya S: For Dedicated: estimate 1x A100 equivalent to start (peak 50 qps, small seq len). We'll refine after perf tests.
Marco V: Make sure to add a fallback route in routing policy to hosted smaller model if Dedicated hits capacity.
Anita C: Acme asked about privacy — they require KMS + customer-managed keys and audit logs.
Priya S: Private key integration is supported for Dedicated with KMS. I will add the checklist item for kms-hsm and compliance review.
eng-ml-oncall: Can we schedule a 30m sync with Acme engineers tomorrow 11am PT to collection assets and run the initial validation? I can join.
Anita C: Confirmed. I'll invite: acme-pm, acme-ml, eng-ml-oncall, Priya S, Marco V, legal@redwood.
Marco V: After sync, plan: perf run -> quantize trial -> safety eval -> canary rollout (1% traffic) -> ramp.
Anita C: Noted. Next update after the sync or if any blockers. :thumbsup:
